'''Asinbayar''' is the fourth largest city in [[Seanchan]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Asinbayar}}

Asinbayar is located on the north-central peninsula of the [[Seanchan (continent)|Seanchan continent]].{{ref/book|bwb}} [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]] is the [[High Lady]] of Asinbayar.{{ref/book|10|6}}
